body: I've started implementing the sliding window algorithm for the rate limiter. Going with a token bucket approach per-user. @david.kim can you review the Redis Lua script?
Looks good! One concern - should we have different rate limits for different endpoint groups? Reads vs writes?
Good point. I'll add a per-route config option. Default 100/min for reads and 30/min for writes.
Found the root cause - we're loading all team members in a loop inside the metrics aggregation. DataLoader will batch these into a single query.
After fix: p95 latency dropped from 1.2s to 180ms on the dashboard endpoint. Verified with load test.
First draft of the chart components is ready for review. Using D3 with React wrapper. Demo: https://staging.meridianlabs.io/charts-preview
The line chart looks great but the bar chart needs better hover states. Also can we add a tooltip with exact values?
Updated with improved tooltips and hover animations. PR: https://github.com/meridian-labs/dashboard/pull/234
Terraform plan looks clean. Creating separate modules for: VPC/networking + RDS + ElastiCache + EKS add-ons.
Can we reproduce the 500 error? I tried special chars in project names and it works fine locally.
Found it - the issue is with emoji characters in project names. The DB column is utf8 not utf8mb4. Need a migration.
Blocking this - we need the auth token format finalized in MER-5 before we can implement cursor-based pagination tokens.
The bundle grew because we imported the entire recharts library. Switching to modular imports + dynamic import() for chart pages.
After code splitting: main bundle back to 252kb. Chart page loads on-demand at 87kb. Lighthouse score improved by 12 points.
This was a production incident at 3am. PgBouncer max_client_conn was set to 100 but we had 150 concurrent connections during batch job.
Fixed by increasing pool size to 200 and adding connection retry with exponential backoff. Also added alerting for pool utilization > 80%.
Cancelling this - after discussion with @priya.sharma we decided to deprecate the legacy webhook format entirely in Q3 and give customers 90 days notice.
Upgrade tested in staging. All pods healthy after 24h soak test. Only breaking change: PodDisruptionBudget API moved to policy/v1.
The race condition was caused by asserting WebSocket.readyState before the connection event fires. Added cy.intercept for deterministic behavior.
The sentinel failover takes 30s because our Sentinel check interval is set to 30000ms. Reducing to 5000ms and adding connection pool pre-warming on failover.
I'm implementing HMAC-SHA256 signing. The signature format will be: t=timestamp v1=hex(hmac-sha256(timestamp.payload secret)). Similar to Stripe's approach.
PR is up for review. Added signature verification helper library that customers can use. Tests cover: valid sig invalid sig expired sig replay attack.
Using UTC offset from the browser's Intl API now. All dates are stored as ISO 8601 with timezone offset and converted to UTC before saving.
APM agent is deployed to all services. Service map is now visible in Datadog. Setting up latency SLOs next.
Refresh token rotation is working. Each refresh invalidates the old token and issues a new pair. Added 7-day absolute expiry for refresh tokens.
